tokens.name: vers-black
tokens.usage: Preto, the only institutional black (brandbook 10-2026, p. 50). sRGB 25 25 25; CMYK 70/60/50/100 in Coated FOGRA39, with small text and fine rules in K100. Ink on white (17.58:1), lime (11.93:1), sky (12.29:1), lilac (9.58:1) and orange (5.34:1); ground of the `vers-dark` theme, covers and team pieces.

tokens.name: vers-black-pure
tokens.usage: Compatibility name: resolves to `vers-black` (#191919), because the brandbook has one black (p. 50). Do not use in new work.

tokens.name: vers-black-slate
tokens.usage: Compatibility name: resolves to `vers-black` (#191919), because the brandbook has one black (p. 50). Do not use in new work.

tokens.name: vers-black-deep
tokens.usage: Compatibility name: resolves to `vers-black` (#191919), because the brandbook has one black (p. 50). Do not use in new work.

tokens.name: vers-graphite
tokens.usage: Grafite (p. 50): structure, never expression. Secondary text on light grounds (11.20:1 on white), rules, dividers, weighted grounds. Composes grafismos, including the logotipo and the symbol used as texture (p. 52), never the brand signature (p. 45). CMYK 20/15/15/90. 1.57:1 on `vers-black`: never text or rules on black.

tokens.name: vers-white
tokens.usage: Branco (p. 50): ground and the negative logotipo. Ink on black (17.58:1), graphite (11.20:1) and indigo (6.39:1). On orange only at 24px+, or 18.66px bold (3.29:1, p. 51).

tokens.name: vers-indigo
tokens.usage: Azul-índigo, the dominant institutional colour (p. 50): proposals, decks, institutional and gift pieces. CMYK 80/67/0/5. Text on white at any size (6.39:1). With lime, sky or lilac, in either direction, only at 24px+ or 18.66px bold (4.34, 4.47 and 3.48:1). Never with orange (1.94:1). On black or graphite only as a block ground or texture, never logotipo, text or information (2.75:1, p. 51).

tokens.name: vers-lime
tokens.usage: Amarelo-limão (p. 50): accent and the public call. CMYK 26/0/88/0. Text or highlight at any size on black (11.93:1) and graphite (7.60:1); on indigo only at 24px+ (4.34:1). Ink on lime is `vers-black`.

tokens.name: vers-orange
tokens.usage: Laranja (p. 50): the high-impact highlight of visitor-facing pieces. CMYK 0/74/86/0. Text on orange is `vers-black` (5.34:1); white or graphite only at 24px+, or 18.66px bold (3.29 and 3.40:1). Orange text at any size on black; never small text on white (3.29:1). Also the alert colour for bars, marks and invalid borders (non-text, 3:1 or more on white).

tokens.name: vers-sky
tokens.usage: Azul-claro (p. 50): light ground, support; planned and scheduled states. CMYK 35/0/11/0. Ink `vers-black` (12.29:1); indigo only at 24px+ (4.47:1). Highlight at any size on black and graphite.

tokens.name: vers-lilac
tokens.usage: Lilás (p. 50): light ground, support; the document colour of receipts (p. 66). CMYK 21/32/1/0. Ink `vers-black` (9.58:1); indigo only at 24px+ (3.48:1). Never text on white (1.83:1). Highlight at any size on black and graphite.

tokens.name: vers-indigo-950
tokens.usage: Interface colour (brandbook p. 45): screens only, never on the logotipo, the symbol or grafismos, never in print or other brand pieces. Floor of the indigo scale: indigo-on-indigo layering below the 900 ground.

tokens.name: vers-indigo-900

Page ground of the `vers-indigo` theme on screen, `Section ground="indigo"`, the base of `overlay-indigo`. White ink 15.02:1, lime 10.19:1. Decks, proposals and print use `vers-indigo`.

tokens.name: vers-indigo-800

tokens.name: vers-indigo-700

tokens.name: vers-indigo-600

tokens.name: vers-indigo-500

tokens.name: vers-indigo-400

tokens.name: vers-indigo-300
tokens.usage: Interface colour (brandbook p. 45): screens only, never on the logotipo, the symbol or grafismos, never in print or other brand pieces. Tint; text on `vers-indigo-900` reads at 7.2:1.

tokens.name: vers-indigo-200

tokens.name: vers-indigo-100

tokens.name: vers-ink-900
tokens.usage: Interface colour (brandbook p. 45): screens only, never on the logotipo, the symbol or grafismos, never in print or other brand pieces. Top of the neutral interface scale; resolves to `vers-black`.

tokens.name: vers-ink-800
tokens.usage: Interface colour (brandbook p. 45): screens only, never on the logotipo, the symbol or grafismos, never in print or other brand pieces. Near-black for large dark interface blocks that must sit apart from `vers-black` (1.31:1 against it). In brand pieces use graphite.

tokens.name: vers-ink-700
tokens.usage: Interface colour (brandbook p. 45): screens only, never on the logotipo, the symbol or grafismos, never in print or other brand pieces. Dark grey for the neutral `Tag` label on `vers-ink-100` (8.41:1).

tokens.name: vers-ink-600
tokens.usage: Interface colour (brandbook p. 45): screens only, never on the logotipo, the symbol or grafismos, never in print or other brand pieces. Mid grey: 5.74:1 on white, for interface metadata only; secondary text on light grounds is graphite (p. 50).

tokens.name: vers-ink-500
tokens.usage: Interface colour (brandbook p. 45): screens only, never on the logotipo, the symbol or grafismos, never in print or other brand pieces. `border-default` and `action-disabled-fg` in the light theme: 3.36:1 on white, enough for a control boundary (p. 51: non-text 3:1), never text.

tokens.name: vers-ink-400
tokens.usage: Interface colour (brandbook p. 45): screens only, never on the logotipo, the symbol or grafismos, never in print or other brand pieces. `status-archive` dots and light decorative rules. 2.19:1 on white: never text, always with a label.

tokens.name: vers-ink-300
tokens.usage: Interface colour (brandbook p. 45): screens only, never on the logotipo, the symbol or grafismos, never in print or other brand pieces. The off `Switch` track and decorative hairlines (1.57:1 on white: never a control boundary).

tokens.name: vers-ink-200
tokens.usage: Interface colour (brandbook p. 45): screens only, never on the logotipo, the symbol or grafismos, never in print or other brand pieces. `border-subtle`, `action-disabled-bg`, the `shadow-inset-rule` colour and empty image wells.

tokens.name: vers-ink-100
tokens.usage: Interface colour (brandbook p. 45): screens only, never on the logotipo, the symbol or grafismos, never in print or other brand pieces. Ghost-button hover wash on light grounds, the neutral `Tag` ground and disabled control fills.

tokens.name: vers-ink-050
tokens.usage: Interface colour (brandbook p. 45): screens only, never on the logotipo, the symbol or grafismos, never in print or other brand pieces. `surface-subtle` in the light theme: alternating paper sections (`Section ground="subtle"`).

tokens.name: vers-lime-200
tokens.usage: Interface colour (brandbook p. 45): screens only, never on the logotipo, the symbol or grafismos, never in print or other brand pieces. `action-accent-bg-hover`: the lime button on hover. Black ink 13.8:1.

tokens.name: vers-lime-100
tokens.usage: Interface colour (brandbook p. 45): screens only, never on the logotipo, the symbol or grafismos, never in print or other brand pieces. Palest lime: a highlight wash behind lime-tagged rows. Never a ground for lime text.

tokens.name: vers-orange-200
tokens.usage: Interface colour (brandbook p. 45): screens only, never on the logotipo, the symbol or grafismos, never in print or other brand pieces. Tint of laranja for warm panels on visitor-facing pieces; ink on it is `vers-black`.

tokens.name: vers-orange-100
tokens.usage: Interface colour (brandbook p. 45): screens only, never on the logotipo, the symbol or grafismos, never in print or other brand pieces. Palest laranja wash for visitor-facing grounds; ink on it is `vers-black`.

tokens.name: vers-sky-200
tokens.usage: Interface colour (brandbook p. 45): screens only, never on the logotipo, the symbol or grafismos, never in print or other brand pieces. Tint of azul claro for planned/scheduled panels; ink `vers-black`.

tokens.name: vers-sky-100
tokens.usage: Interface colour (brandbook p. 45): screens only, never on the logotipo, the symbol or grafismos, never in print or other brand pieces. Palest azul claro wash; ink `vers-black`.

tokens.name: vers-lilac-200
tokens.usage: Interface colour (brandbook p. 45): screens only, never on the logotipo, the symbol or grafismos, never in print or other brand pieces. Tint of lilás for soft panels; ink `vers-black`.

tokens.name: vers-lilac-100
tokens.usage: Interface colour (brandbook p. 45): screens only, never on the logotipo, the symbol or grafismos, never in print or other brand pieces. Palest lilás wash; ink `vers-black`.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body and heading ink on `surface-page`, `surface-subtle` and `surface-raised` in every theme: #191919 on white (17.58:1, p. 51); white on `vers-black` (17.58:1) and on `vers-indigo-900` (15.02:1).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Ledes, panel copy and secondary lines. Light: graphite, the brandbook's secondary text (pp. 50, 66), 11.20:1 on white. vers-dark 9.56:1; vers-indigo 8.81:1 on the page ground (interface derivations of white, p. 45).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Eyebrows, captions and metadata. Light: graphite (11.20:1), because the brandbook gives light grounds two text tones, #191919 and graphite; set muted text apart by size, not by a paler grey. vers-dark 5.58:1; vers-indigo 5.39:1 on the page ground and 4.59:1 on `surface-subtle`.

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Ink on `surface-inverse`: white on black in light, black on white in vers-dark, indigo-900 on white in vers-indigo (15.02:1).

tokens.name: text-accent
tokens.usage: Accent ink for eyebrows (`Eyebrow tone="accent"`, `Section` eyebrows) and `Stat tone="accent"`: indigo on white (6.39:1) in light; lime on black (11.93:1) and on indigo-900 (10.19:1) in the dark themes. Never indigo text on black (p. 51).

tokens.name: text-on-accent
tokens.usage: Ink on `action-accent-bg`, `surface-lime` and any lime fill: always `vers-black` (11.93:1), in every theme.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page ground: white (light), `vers-black` (vers-dark), `vers-indigo-900` (vers-indigo).

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Alternating section ground one step off the page: `vers-ink-050`, #272727 (vers-dark), `vers-indigo-800`. Interface colours (p. 45).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Ground of dialogs, menus and raised panels (with `shadow-raise` or `shadow-overlay`); equal to the page in the light theme.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: The opposite ground for closing bands and stamps; its ink is `text-inverse`.

tokens.name: surface-graphite
tokens.usage: Weighted ground without the closure of black (`Section ground="graphite"`); white ink 11.20:1; lime, sky and lilac highlights at any size (p. 51).

tokens.name: surface-indigo
tokens.usage: Flat indigo panel or the portfolio's indigo case ground (#4B59A7), the indigo of decks and print; white ink 6.39:1; lime only at 24px+ (4.34:1).

tokens.name: surface-indigo-deep
tokens.usage: Interface colour (brandbook p. 45): screens only, never on the logotipo, the symbol or grafismos, never in print or other brand pieces. The `vers-indigo` theme's page colour on screen. Not a deck or proposal ground: brand pieces use `surface-indigo` (p. 50).

tokens.name: surface-lime
tokens.usage: Lime copy panels, figure chips and the cover and closing slide grounds; ink is `text-on-accent` (11.93:1); indigo only at 24px+ (4.34:1).

tokens.name: surface-orange
tokens.usage: Visitor-facing ground (posters, totems, banners): `vers-black` ink at any size (5.34:1); white only at 24px+ or 18.66px bold (3.29:1); never indigo (1.94:1).

tokens.name: surface-sky
tokens.usage: Secondary ground in the deck rotation; ink `vers-black` (12.29:1); `vers-indigo` only at 24px+ (4.47:1).

tokens.name: surface-lilac
tokens.usage: Secondary ground in the deck rotation; ink `vers-black` (9.58:1); `vers-indigo` only at 24px+ (3.48:1).

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card rules, the `Tabs` baseline, figcaption rules, `Rule tone="subtle"`.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Control borders (`Input`, `Select`, `Textarea`, outline `Tag`) and `Rule tone="default"`: at least 3:1 against the ground, as the brandbook's criterion asks of non-text elements (p. 51). Light 3.36:1 on white; vers-dark 3.35:1 on the page and 3.24:1 on `surface-subtle`; vers-indigo 3.64:1 and 3.23:1.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Ink-strength rules: `Rule tone="strong"`, `hr`, outline buttons, checkbox and radio borders (17.58:1 on white).

tokens.name: border-inverse
tokens.usage: White hairline at 28% for rules on dark and indigo grounds where the theme scope is not switched.

tokens.name: action-primary-bg
tokens.usage: Primary `Button` fill: black in light; lime in vers-dark and vers-indigo.

tokens.name: action-primary-fg
tokens.usage: Primary `Button` label: white on black; black on lime (vers-dark); indigo-900 on lime (vers-indigo).

tokens.name: action-primary-bg-hover
tokens.usage: Primary `Button` on hover: indigo in light, white in the dark themes. Hover swaps the ground; nothing scales.

tokens.name: action-accent-bg
tokens.usage: Accent `Button` (the single most important action on a surface): lime, in every theme.

tokens.name: action-accent-fg
tokens.usage: Accent `Button` label: `vers-black` on lime (11:1).

tokens.name: action-accent-bg-hover
tokens.usage: Accent `Button` on hover: `vers-lime-200`.

tokens.name: action-disabled-bg
tokens.usage: Disabled buttons and controls: `vers-ink-200` fill, no opacity tricks.

tokens.name: action-disabled-fg
tokens.usage: Disabled label: `vers-ink-500` on `action-disabled-bg` (2.62:1; disabled states are exempt from the contrast floor).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid at 2px offset on every focusable element, always visible on keyboard focus. Light: indigo, 6.39:1 on white, 4.34:1 on lime, 3.48:1 on lilac; on an orange ground use #191919 (indigo there is 1.94:1). Dark themes: lime, 11.93:1 on black and 10.19:1 on indigo-900, because indigo never carries information on black (p. 51).

tokens.name: link-color
tokens.usage: Links: indigo in light (6.39:1 on white), lime in the dark themes (11.93:1 on black). The 1px underline is always present, never added on hover.

tokens.name: link-color-hover
tokens.usage: Link on hover: black in light, white in the dark themes. Colour changes only.

tokens.name: status-live
tokens.usage: A season in operation: live dots and chips in lime. Pair with a word, never colour alone (p. 51).

tokens.name: status-planned
tokens.usage: Planned or scheduled: azul claro dots and chips, with a label.

tokens.name: status-archive
tokens.usage: Archived or past: `vers-ink-400` dots and chips (2.19:1 on white: always with a label).

tokens.name: status-alert
tokens.usage: Alerts and errors as non-text: the `Toast tone="alert"` bar, the mark beside a `Field` error, invalid control borders (3.29:1 on white, 5.34:1 on black). Never as small text on light grounds: the error message itself is `text-primary` (p. 51).

tokens.name: overlay-scrim
tokens.usage: 55% black veil for text legibility over photography (`MediaFrame protect="scrim"`).

tokens.name: overlay-scrim-strong
tokens.usage: 78% black: the `Dialog` backdrop.

tokens.name: overlay-indigo
tokens.usage: 72% indigo-900 veil for institutional section covers over photography (`MediaFrame protect="indigo"`).

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Nebulica Black, uppercase, -0.03em, 0.94 leading. Titles are cut, not typed: reach for these on covers, heroes, statement slides and section titles. The tagline has its own composition (Signature).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Uppercase. Hero and cover statements; `size-display-xl`. The tagline is not set here: use `tagline-1` and `tagline-2`.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Uppercase. Statement and case-opener titles on a 1280×720 slide (62–88px); `size-display-l`.

styles.name: display-m
styles.sample: A obra é vivida a partir de dentro
styles.usage: Uppercase. Site hero titles and the `h1` default; `size-display-m`.

styles.name: display-s
styles.usage: Uppercase. `Section` titles and content headlines (32–48px on a slide); `size-display-s`.

groups.name: Headings
groups.note: Nebulica Bold, sentence case, -0.01em, 1.14 leading. Content headlines, panel titles, card titles.

styles.name: heading-l
styles.usage: Sentence case. `h2`, content headlines, `Dialog` titles; `size-heading-l`.

styles.name: heading-m
styles.usage: Sentence case. `h3`, `WorkCard` titles; `size-heading-m`.

styles.name: heading-s
styles.usage: Sentence case. `h4`, panel titles (17–25px on a slide); `size-heading-s`.

groups.name: Body
groups.note: Elgraine for all running copy: 1.55 leading, measure capped at `measure-prose` (62ch). Never Nebulica for long passages.

styles.name: body-xl
styles.sample: Presença não é apenas o efeito de estar dentro de uma experiência.
styles.usage: Ledes on statement pages; the minimum type size on a 1920×1080 slide; `size-body-xl`.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: É a passagem de uma obra da representação para a vivência.
styles.usage: `Section` ledes and editorial ledes, measure `measure-lede`; `size-body-l`.

styles.name: body-m
styles.sample: A VERS existe para transformar obras, narrativas, patrimônios, memórias e conhecimentos em experiências imersivas.
styles.usage: Default running copy; `size-body-m`.

styles.name: body-s
styles.sample: Operação itinerante de VR em praça pública, com mediação e fluxo contínuo.
styles.usage: Controls, card summaries, panel copy on slides (15–21px); the minimum body size on screen; `size-body-s`.

groups.name: Labels
groups.note: Nebulica, uppercase, tracked: the system's metadata voice.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase Nebulica Medium (brandbook pp. 63, 65). Eyebrows above every display headline, field labels, nav links, tab labels, `Stat` labels; `size-eyebrow` + `tracking-eyebrow`.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Uppercase for credits, tags and metadata; sentence case for help text and captions; `size-caption` + `tracking-label`.

groups.name: Signature
groups.note: The brandbook's own compositions. Tagline (p. 6): two lines, Nebulica Medium then Nebulica Black, same size, sentence case, no full stop; in running text it takes the text's font. Descriptor (p. 46): Elgraine Bold Italic under the logotipo, right-aligned.

styles.name: tagline-1
styles.usage: First line of the composed tagline (p. 6, set there at 75px on a 1920px page). Scale both lines together; never uppercase.

styles.name: tagline-2
styles.usage: Second line of the composed tagline (p. 6), the same size as `tagline-1`. Never in permanent lockup with the logotipo (p. 47).

styles.name: descriptor
styles.usage: Descriptor locked up with the logotipo (p. 46): 0.17 times the logotipo's height, under it and right-aligned, in its colour; 15px pairs with an 88px-tall logotipo. `Logo descriptor` sets it.
